name: TAI-04 Candidate Interview & Final Grade v1

parameters.formDescription: Start a graded technical interview for a candidate whose resume was already extracted and graded by Phase 1.

values.placeholder: Resume extraction UUID from the completed assessment

parameters.query:
WITH requested AS
(
    SELECT $1::UUID AS extraction_id
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN re.id IS NULL
            THEN 'EXTRACTION_NOT_FOUND'
        WHEN re.status <> 'EXTRACTED'
            THEN 'EXTRACTION_NOT_READY'
        WHEN re.profile_schema_version <> '1.0'
            THEN 'PROFILE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED'
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(re.profile) <> 'object'
            THEN 'PROFILE_INVALID'
        WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(re.target_grade_code), '') IS NULL
             OR re.target_grade_code = 'UNSPECIFIED'
            THEN 'TARGET_GRADE_UNSPECIFIED'
        WHEN gg.id IS NULL
            THEN 'ACTIVE_GRADE_GUIDE_NOT_FOUND'
        WHEN selected_grade.grade_definition IS NULL
            THEN 'TARGET_GRADE_NOT_FOUND'
        WHEN latest_assessment.id IS NULL
            THEN 'RESUME_GRADE_NOT_FOUND'
        ELSE 'RESOLVED'
    END AS "resolutionStatus",

    CASE
        WHEN re.id IS NULL
            THEN 'Resume extraction was not found.'
        WHEN re.status <> 'EXTRACTED'
            THEN 'Resume extraction is not ready for the interview.'
        WHEN re.profile_schema_version <> '1.0'
            THEN 'Resume profile schema version is not supported.'
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(re.profile) <> 'object'
            THEN 'Resume profile must be a JSON object.'
        WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(re.target_grade_code), '') IS NULL
             OR re.target_grade_code = 'UNSPECIFIED'
            THEN 'Target grade code is not specified.'
        WHEN gg.id IS NULL
            THEN 'No active grade guide exists for the requested position.'
        WHEN selected_grade.grade_definition IS NULL
            THEN 'Target grade does not exist in the active grade guide.'
        WHEN latest_assessment.id IS NULL
            THEN 'No completed resume grade assessment exists for this extraction.'
        ELSE 'Candidate interview context resolved successfully.'
    END AS "resolutionMessage",

    requested.extraction_id                 AS "requestedExtractionId",
    re.id                                   AS "extractionId",
    re.position_code                        AS "positionCode",
    re.target_grade_code                    AS "targetGradeCode",
    re.source_file_name                     AS "sourceFileName",
    re.job_description                      AS "jobDescription",
    re.profile                              AS profile,
    gg.id                                   AS "gradeGuideId",
    gg.guide_version                        AS "gradeGuideVersion",
    gg.guide_schema_version                 AS "gradeGuideSchemaVersion",
    selected_grade.grade_definition         AS "gradeDefinition",
    gg.guide -> 'dimensions'                AS dimensions,
    gg.guide -> 'scoringScale'              AS "scoringScale",
    gg.guide -> 'grades'                    AS grades,
    latest_assessment.id                    AS "resumeAssessmentId",
    latest_assessment.overall_score         AS "resumeOverallScore",
    latest_assessment.minimum_overall_score AS "resumeMinimumOverallScore",
    latest_assessment.threshold_met         AS "resumeThresholdMet",
    latest_assessment.mandatory_dimensions_met AS "resumeMandatoryDimensionsMet",
    latest_assessment.decision              AS "resumeDecision",
    latest_assessment.dimension_assessments AS "resumeDimensionAssessments",
    latest_assessment.assessment_summary    AS "resumeAssessmentSummary",
    latest_assessment.created_at            AS "resumeAssessedAt"
FROM requested
LEFT JOIN talentai.resume_extraction AS re
       ON re.id = requested.extraction_id
LEFT JOIN talentai.grade_guide AS gg
       ON gg.position_code = re.position_code
      AND gg.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL
(
    SELECT grade AS grade_definition
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(
        COALESCE(gg.guide -> 'grades', '[]'::JSONB)
    ) AS grade
    WHERE grade ->> 'code' = re.target_grade_code
    LIMIT 1
) AS selected_grade ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL
(
    SELECT ga.*
    FROM talentai.grade_assessment AS ga
    WHERE ga.extraction_id = requested.extraction_id
      AND ga.status = 'COMPLETED'
    ORDER BY ga.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS latest_assessment ON TRUE;

parameters.jsCode:
const config = $input.first().json;

const interviewContext =
  $('Build Interview Context').first().json;

const roundConfig = config.rounds.first;

const instructions = [
  'You are the interview-designer component of TalentAI.',
  '',
  'Your only responsibility is to design the first-round candidate interview questionnaire.',
  'You must not decide the final grade.',
  'You must not score or evaluate the candidate.',
  'You must not calculate any final score.',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '1. Produce exactly ' + roundConfig.totalQuestions + ' questions.',
  '2. Produce exactly ' + roundConfig.singleChoice + ' single_choice, ' + roundConfig.multiChoice + ' multi_choice and ' + roundConfig.explanatory + ' explanatory questions.',
  '3. Every question belongs to exactly one dimension from gradeGuide.dimensions, using its exact code.',
  '4. Every dimension must receive between 2 and 4 questions, and every dimension must be covered.',
  '5. A single_choice question is a radio question with exactly one best answer and 3 or 4 options.',
  '6. A multi_choice question has 4 to 6 options and several of them can be correct; the candidate may select multiple options.',
  '7. Every option must carry an integer score from 0 to 4 that follows gradeGuide.scoringScale.',
  '8. For multi_choice questions, score each option on its own quality: 4 for a strong and correct component, 0 for a wrong or harmful component.',
  '9. Include plausible distractor options that sound confident but demonstrate shallow or incorrect understanding.',
  '10. Questions must be tailored to this candidate: probe the skills and claims in candidateProfile,',
  '   focus on dimensions where resumeGrade shows low scores, low confidence, or a large distance to the target grade,',
  '   and ask explanatory questions about concrete projects from workExperiences.',
  '11. Explanatory questions must ask for specific first-hand experience, decisions, trade-offs, or troubleshooting stories.',
  '12. Questions must be answerable without confidential or proprietary employer data.',
  '13. Write every question and every option in Persian (Farsi), addressed directly to the candidate.',
  '14. Do not include scores, scoring scale, or dimension codes inside the visible question or option text.',
  '15. Generate unique question ids matching the pattern Q01 to Q' + String(roundConfig.totalQuestions).padStart(2, '0') + '.',
  '16. Return only the object required by the connected Structured Output Parser.',
  '',
  'Interview context:',
  JSON.stringify(interviewContext),
];

return [
  {
    json: {
      interviewContext,
      config,
      prompt: instructions.join(
        '\n'
      ),
    },
  },
];
